title: Brand Manager
description:
Brand Manager

Location: Leeds (Hybrid Working - 3 days office, 2 days home)
Salary: Up to 50,000 Basic + Company Benefits

Our client is a fast-growing consumer brand with a strong presence across retail, e-commerce, and digital channels. Known for innovation, creativity, and customer-centric product development, they are looking to appoint an experienced Brand Manager to drive brand growth.

As Brand Manager, you will take ownership of the brand strategy, ensuring consistent messaging and execution across all consumer touchpoints. Reporting into Marketing Director you will be responsible for delivering brand campaigns, managing product launches, and leading one direct report.

This is an excellent opportunity for a commercially minded marketing professional with previous brand management experience within consumer products, beauty, FMCG, or retail sectors.

Key Responsibilities:
- Develop and execute brand strategies to drive awareness, engagement, and revenue growth.
- Lead the planning and delivery of integrated marketing campaigns across digital, social, retail, and PR channels.
- Manage the full product launch lifecycle, from concept through to market execution.
- Analyse market trends, competitor activity, and consumer insights to identify growth opportunities.
- Work closely with sales, product development, and external agency partners.
- Monitor campaign performance and ROI, providing recommendations for continuous improvement.
- Manage and mentor one direct report, supporting their development and performance.
- Ensure brand consistency across all customer touchpoints.
- Oversee marketing budgets and campaign spend.

Skills Required:
- Must have proven experience working in a similar Brand Manager or Product Marketing/Consumer Marketing role
- Previous experience working within a consumer, FMCG, or personal care sector is essential
- Experience managing and developing at least one direct report
- Strong understanding of brand strategy, campaign management, and consumer marketing
- Commercially aware with the ability to analyse data and translate insights into action
- Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
- Experience managing agencies and external partners
- Degree-qualified in Marketing, Business, or a related discipline preferred

title: External Communications Manager
description:
An exciting opportunity for an experienced communications professional to lead external communications, media relations and reputation management for a nationally recognised organisation. You'll develop compelling stories, deliver integrated campaigns and provide strategic communications advice to senior stakeholders while helping to protect and enhance organisational reputation

Our client is a large, purpose-driven organisation with a strong regional and national presence based in Leeds. They play a vital role in supporting communities, customers and key infrastructure, and are committed to delivering trusted services, driving innovation and maintaining a positive reputation through effective stakeholder engagement and storytelling.

Description
- Lead the development and delivery of external communications strategies that enhance reputation and build trust with key audiences.
- Create engaging content across multiple channels, including media relations, articles, case studies, leadership communications, digital content and social media.
- Identify and develop compelling stories from across the organisation, turning complex subjects into clear and accessible communications.
- Manage press office activity, responding to media enquiries and proactively securing positive media opportunities.
- Support reputation management initiatives, providing communications advice on high-profile, sensitive and business-critical issues.

- Plan and deliver integrated communications campaigns, working closely with colleagues across marketing, digital, stakeholder engagement and leadership teams.

A successful External Communications Manager should have:

title: Marketing Manager
description:
An established and growing environmental and sustainability consultancy is looking to appoint a Digital Marketing Manager to take ownership of its marketing activity and help shape the next stage of its growth.The business is an SME and has built a strong client base largely through repeat business, referrals and its reputation within the market. They are looking to bring Marketing in-house and appoint someone who can develop and lead a more structured marketing approach.
This is a newly created position with significant autonomy. Reporting directly to the board, you will be given the opportunity to assess the current marketing activity, identify where improvements can be made and develop a clear plan for how marketing can support the wider commercial objectives of the business.
Initially, there will be a strong focus on digital lead generation, alongside improving the company's website and developing its approach across SEO, PPC, content, social media and wider brand activity.
You won't be expected to be a technical expert in technical consultancy. The business has experienced divisional heads and subject matter experts who will provide the technical knowledge, insight and content required. Your role will be to translate that expertise into effective B2 B marketing activity.
Key responsibilities:
- Take ownership of the overall marketing approach and develop a clear marketing plan.
- Review existing marketing activity and identify opportunities for improvement.
- Develop digital campaigns focused on generating relevant B2 B enquiries.
- Improve and optimise the company's website and digital presence.
- Manage and develop SEO and PPC activity.
- Build a more consistent approach to content and thought leadership.
- Develop the company's use of social media and wider digital channels.
- Identify opportunities to increase brand awareness and market presence.
- Work closely with divisional heads to understand their markets, customers and commercial priorities.
- Manage external agencies and suppliers where appropriate.
- Establish appropriate measures to understand marketing performance and return on investment.

About you:
The business is deliberately keeping an open mind around the exact background and level of the person appointed. They are particularly interested in speaking with people who have:
- Strong B2 B marketing experience.
- Broad digital marketing knowledge rather than experience limited to one channel.
- Experience across areas such as SEO, PPC, websites, content and social media.
- A commercial approach to marketing with an understanding of lead generation.
- The ability to develop strategy while remaining comfortable with hands-on delivery.
- Experience working autonomously and taking ownership of marketing activity.
- Confidence working directly with senior stakeholders and subject matter experts.
- The ability to turn complex or technical information into effective marketing content.

Experience within professional services, consultancy or another technical B2 B environment would be useful but isn't essential.

title: Pr Manager
description:
Are you a PR professional who wants to make a real impact with a premium brand and take your carrer to the next level?

This is an exciting opportunity to join a fast-growing, ambitious B2 C business and take ownership of its PR activity at an important stage of growth.

We're looking for someone commercially minded, proactive and ambitious who knows how to get brands noticed. Someone who can build strong media relationships, create compelling stories and, importantly, turn those relationships into meaningful coverage across the right consumer, national and broadcast media.

This is a hands-on role where you'll have the opportunity to make your mark and help shape the PR strategy as the business continues to scale.

The Role
- Develop and deliver the PR strategy, aligned to the wider commercial and growth objectives of the business
- Build strong relationships with journalists, editors, broadcasters and key media contacts
- Identify opportunities to secure high-value coverage across consumer, lifestyle, luxury and national media
- Proactively pitch stories and create campaigns that generate genuine interest and attention
- Develop opportunities for TV, radio and other broadcast coverage
- Create compelling press releases, pitches, stories and briefing materials
- Identify reactive PR opportunities and move quickly when relevant stories break
- Work closely with marketing, content and senior leadership to turn business activity into PR opportunities
- Track and report on PR performance, measuring coverage, reach and commercial impact
- Manage external PR partners where required
- Help shape the company's reputation and position within its market
- Play an important role in developing the PR function as the business grows, with the opportunity to build a team in the future

What We're Looking For
- Proven PR experience within a B2 C environment - this is essential
- Experience working with premium, high-end or luxury brands
- A strong track record of securing quality media coverage, ideally including national and/or broadcast
- Excellent existing relationships with journalists and media contacts
- A strong commercial mindset and an understanding that PR should contribute to business growth
- Experience in a scaling, entrepreneurial or fast-paced business would be highly advantageous
- Someone proactive, ambitious and confident enough to create opportunities rather than simply wait for them
- A natural storyteller who understands what makes a brand or story newsworthy
- Comfortable working with data and measuring the impact of PR activity
- Someone who is excited by the opportunity to grow with a business and ultimately help build a PR function around them

Why This Role?
This is a chance to join a business with ambitious growth plans and big ambitions for its brand.

You'll have the freedom to make a real impact, build relationships with some of the most influential media and help take the brand into new spaces - including national and TV coverage.

For the right person, there is also a genuine opportunity to grow the role and build a PR team as the business continues to scale.

Apply now for immediate consideration and further details.

title: Referral & Affiliate Marketing Specialist
description:
Want to build a marketing programme that directly drives new customers?

This isn't a traditional marketing role focused on brand awareness, content or social media. Instead, you'll take ownership of building and growing a high-performing referral and affiliate programme, designed to turn existing customers and external partners into a powerful source of new customer acquisition.

Working for one of Leeds' leading D2 C businesses, you'll develop the strategy, build the referral platform and create campaigns that encourage customers to recommend the business to others. You'll test different approaches, analyse the data and continually optimise performance to increase referrals and generate measurable growth.

If you're commercially minded, enjoy working with data and are motivated by seeing a clear uplift in customer numbers, this is an excellent opportunity to take ownership of a programme with real commercial impact.

The Role

As Referral & Affiliate Programme Manager, you'll be responsible for developing and implementing a full-mix referral and affiliate marketing strategy designed to acquire new customers.

You'll identify opportunities to increase referrals, develop compelling customer and partner propositions, manage campaigns and use performance data to understand what's working and where further growth can be achieved.

This is a highly commercial marketing role where success will be measured by customer acquisition, referral growth and the incremental revenue generated.

Key Responsibilities
- Build and develop the company's referral and affiliate programme
- Create strategies that encourage existing customers to refer new customers
- Develop campaigns, incentives and communications to maximise referral activity
- Identify new referral and affiliate opportunities across relevant channels
- Manage and optimise the referral platform and associated processes
- Develop a full-mix marketing strategy to drive programme participation
- Analyse customer, referral and campaign data to identify growth opportunities
- Track acquisition, conversion, ROI and incremental customer numbers
- Test different propositions and campaigns and use results to continually optimise performance
- Produce regular performance reporting and recommendations
- Work closely with the wider marketing team to ensure referral activity supports wider acquisition objectives
- Build relationships with relevant external partners and affiliates
- Continually look for new ways to increase the volume and quality of referred customers

We're Looking For Someone Who
- Has experience in referral, affiliate, performance, direct or digital marketing
- Understands how marketing activity can directly drive customer acquisition
- Is commercially minded and motivated by measurable results
- Enjoys working with data and using insight to improve performance
- Is comfortable being measured against customer acquisition and growth targets
- Has experience developing campaigns and testing different approaches
- Is highly organised and able to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously
- Thinks creatively about how to turn customers and partners into acquisition channels
- Has strong Excel or spreadsheet skills and is confident analysing performance data
- Is proactive, analytical and comfortable taking ownership of a programme
- Wants to play a key role in the growth of an ambitious, fast-moving business

Why Apply?

This is an opportunity to take ownership of a growing acquisition channel and build something with genuine commercial value.

You'll have the opportunity to shape the referral strategy, develop the platform, test new ideas and see directly how your work translates into more customers and increased revenue.

If you're looking for a role that combines marketing strategy, customer acquisition, data and commercial performance, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today for immediate consideration.

Campaign Assistant - Digital Ad Operations Specialist

- Make or coordinate campaign optimisations to improve delivery and performance.
- Produce accurate and timely campaign reports, highlighting results, challenges and recommended actions.

- Work collaboratively with internal teams, agencies, suppliers and media technology partners.
- Support the development of consistent campaign-management processes and ways of working.
- Keep up to date with developments across onsite retail media, programmatic display, paid social and other offsite channels.

About You
- Experience in digital media, ecommerce, marketing, campaign operations or a similar role is desirable.
- An understanding of digital campaign delivery, including trafficking, monitoring, optimisation and reporting.
- Awareness of onsite and offsite media channels, such as sponsored products, digital display, programmatic media or paid social.
- Strong attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines accurately.
- Comfortable working with campaign data and using it to identify issues and opportunities.
- Strong organisational, communication and stakeholder-management skills.
- Able to work independently while contributing effectively within a wider, cross-functional team.
- Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities, platforms and processes continue to evolve.
- A proactive approach to problem-solving and a willingness to learn new media platforms and technology.

title: Media Buyer - Paid Social

You'll play a key role in developing and executing paid social strategies that reach relevant audiences, generate high-quality leads and deliver measurable commercial results.

Key Responsibilities
- Plan, execute and optimise paid social campaigns across Meta, TikTok, Reddit and other relevant platforms.
- Drive efficient lead generation and acquisition, delivering against agreed CPL, CPA and performance targets.
- Audit and evaluate advertising accounts, identifying opportunities to improve performance, efficiency and scalability.
- Work closely with the Creative Strategist to develop paid social strategies aligned with the objectives of each campaign and market vertical.
- Support creative testing across ad formats, messaging, audiences and concepts to identify winning combinations.
- Analyse platform performance data and internal business intelligence to inform daily optimisation decisions.
- Use downstream lead quality and disposition data, where available, to improve campaign effectiveness and acquisition quality.

- Experience in direct-to-consumer (DTC) performance marketing or high-volume lead generation.
- Experience managing substantial advertising budgets or campaigns across multiple market verticals.
- Familiarity with Reddit Ads or additional paid social platforms beyond Meta and TikTok.

title: Senior Paid Media Executive
description:
Role: Senior Paid Media Executive- Wakefield

Salary: £35k- £37k DOE

Hours: Monday- Friday 40 hours per week

Benefits:
- Hybrid Working 3: days in office
- Flexible Working Times
- Social events

Position Overview:

Elevation Recruitment are partnering with a fast growing e-commerce retailer.

Unlike many online competitors, they design and manufacture our own products right here in the UK.

With a marketing investment exceeding £10 million annually and a growing team of around 300 colleagues, we are a data-driven, performance-focused business with significant scale and momentum. As we enter the next phase of our growth, we have ambitious plans to further expand our digital presence and performance marketing capabilities.

We're now looking for a talented and driven Paid Media Executive to join our team someone who is excited by growth, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and wants to play a key role in shaping the next chapter of our success.

Working across a portfolio of websites, our Paid Media Executive will be a data-driven digital marketing professional responsible for managing and optimising paid advertising campaigns to drive targeted traffic and maximise return on investment (ROI). This will include both Paid Search (e.g., Google and Microsoft Bing Ads) and Paid Social (e.g., Meta, Pinterest and TikTok Ads) to ensure a cohesive biddable media strategy, while working within our business budgets and KPI metrics.

Responsibilities:
- Direct paid search strategy and campaign management in line with company objectives, driving market share growth while maintaining effective sales reserve budgets and PPC spend ratios.
- Managing and optimising campaigns across multiple Search and Shopping platforms, including Google Ads and Microsoft Ads, while driving remarketing and upper-funnel prospecting through paid social channels.
- The right candidate would be expected to manage the above across multiple domains covering both retail and B2 C.
- Manage cross-channel campaign alignment to prevent audience overlap and optimise budget efficiency across platforms.
- Identify new target groups through keyword and audience research, developing suitable new campaigns.
- Build and optimise new and existing campaigns to effectively target newly launched products.
- Lead regular SQR analysis across multiple campaigns, implementing negative keyword strategies and refining campaign structures to improve relevance, efficiency, and overall performance.
- Optimise campaign performance through A/B testing of ad copy, creative assets, landing pages, and shopping feeds.
- Manage shopping feeds to optimise performance through product selection, ad titles, and imagery.
- Develop and maintain comprehensive PPC and eCommerce reporting to support data-driven decision-making across the business.
- Manage weekly and monthly work in progress trackers to ensure alignment with business objectives.
- Providing effectively structured and presented updates into line manager.

Essential Requirements:
- Minimum 3 years PPC experience at either an agency or in-house role.
- A strong candidate will have a keen interest in eCommerce marketing, with understanding of cross-channel interactions and their impact on performance.
- Highly self-motivated and performance-focused, committed to maximising results in line with company KPIs.
- Proven track record of managing and optimising multiple paid Search and Shopping campaigns on Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising.
- Highly proficient with strong attention to detail in preparing, analysing, and deriving recommendations from large data sets.
- Skilled in using Google Analytics 4 for tracking and analysing website and campaign performance

Desirable Requirements:
- Knowledge of attribution models with experience forecasting and reporting campaign performance accordingly.
- Proficient with Microsoft office especially Microsoft Excel & Google sheets.
- Intermediate experience using Google Analytics (GA/GA4).
- Commercially minded with a focus on performance and ROI.
